scripts.text: [Han Garam]
I am Han Garam, and a heir of a formerly renown family.
scripts.translation: 我叫韓加藍，是昔日名門的繼承

scripts.text: Do you want to know why I say ''formerly renown''?
scripts.translation: 人。為什麼說是“昔日名門

scripts.text: It is because my grandfather lost my family's wealth,
and now we are just like other ordinary families, hahahaha!
scripts.translation: 我們也就是個普通人家，哈哈哈！

scripts.text: [Han Garam]
I have inherited nothing but this traditional hat making skill.
scripts.translation: 我繼承的只有這項傳統帽子製作技藝。即便

scripts.text: Even then, it is a quite extraordinary inheritance,
scripts.translation: 如此，這也是一份相當非凡的遺產

scripts.text: since I am the only one in the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom
scripts.translation: ，因為我是盧恩·米德加茲王國唯一能

scripts.text: who can make traditional hats.
[Han Garam]
Unfortunately, I haven't been able to
scripts.translation: 可惜最近沒能請來龍神

scripts.text: exercise my skill because I haven't met with the Dragon God...
Eh? What do I mean, you ask?
You know what mediums do, right?
They receive spirits into their bodies,
and communicate with them.
[Han Garam]
So, in my case, a Dragon God comes into my body,
scripts.translation: 對我來說，就是請龍神附身，

scripts.text: and gives me strength and wisdom.
When my family was wealthy,
we had enough invocation materials
to summon the Dragon God,
but now, as you see,
we cannot afford such expensive things.
scripts.translation: 買不起那麼貴重的祭品。

scripts.text: [Han Garam]
Basically, I may have inherited my family's heirloom,
scripts.translation: 說白了，我繼承了家傳手

scripts.text: but I can't use it
because I cannot afford buying the invocation materials.
scripts.translation: 不起祭品，也就沒法施展。

scripts.text: [Han Garam]
To summon the Dragon God,
I must have ^FF00007 Bijous for each of the 4 Bijou colors^000000.
^FF0000I need 7 Bijous for each of the Blue,
^FF0000Yellow, Green, and Red colors^000000.
Basically I need total 28 Bijous...umm.
[Han Garam]
As I said earlier, not only they are expensive,
scripts.translation: 剛才說了，這些東西既貴又難

scripts.text: but also they are hard to find...
*Sigh* I am afraid that my family's heirloom skill
scripts.translation: 嘆氣*恐怕祖傳的手藝就要斷送

scripts.text: might be discontinued at my generation...
